name: SatNOGS RF Ingest Flow
description: Per-provider ingest flow, RF spectrum: a cron TIMER tick enters at satnogs-source:request, which emits ONE whole-table hostcap/http-request GET of the SatNOGS DB transmitters API (bulk, never a pagination walk) carrying the identifying User-Agent the source-policy.json fetch discipline mandates. satnogs-source:parse joins that job with the response, decodes ~4,994 transmitter rows into a size-prefixed $RFB record stream (batch = sha256 of the payload; Hz -> MHz per the normative RFB units rule; one record per LINK_DIRECTION so a Transceiver/Transponder becomes an UPLINK+DOWNLINK pair sharing ID_TRANSMITTER), and hostcap/storage-ingest persists it through the policy-mediated storage.ingest_with_source cap op. SatNOGS DB is CC-BY-SA-4.0: every record carries the attribution in CITATION and the batch meta carries license/license_url/citation, keeping the share-alike obligation contained to its own licence-marked batch. Results land on the egress sink. All decisions live in-wasm; the host supplies only the http and storage connectors.

edges._comment: NOT opaque: both ports resolve the concrete $RFB identity, so the record type is declared on the wire rather than signed away.

triggers.description: SatNOGS transmitter sync timer. DAILY, per the source-policy.json cadence ruling: SatNOGS DB is a volunteer-run catalogue that changes on the order of days, so aggressive polling is abuse regardless of what robots.txt permits. This is deliberately NOT the 3h GP cadence.
